steps.observation: Work on this for 60 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three high-impact strategies cities can pursue to cut carbon emissions:

1. Sustainable Mobility  
   • Expand and modernize public transit (bus rapid transit, light rail)  
   • Build protected bike lanes and pedestrian zones  
   • Incentivize electric vehicle uptake (EV charging networks, low-emission zones)

2. Clean Energy and Grid Decarbonization  
   • Procure or generate more renewables (rooftop solar, community wind farms)  
   • Deploy energy storage and smart-grid technologies to balance supply  
   • Phase out coal and high-carbon fuels in district heating and power plants

3. Green Building and Urban Planning  
   • Enforce stringent energy-efficiency codes for new construction  
   • Retrofit existing stock with insulation, efficient HVAC, LED lighting  
   • Use mixed-use, higher-density zoning plus green roofs/urban forests to shorten commutes and sequester CO₂
